notes: Italian/Dutch microreactor developer listed via SPAC (GSR III Acquisition Corp.) on 2025-10-09, ticker NKLR, CIK 2067627. Census lifetime figure of $130M (Nasdaq closing release) could not be re-verified: the release page was not archivable. [Verifier 2026-10-05] SPAC amount now recorded from the FY2025 10-K cash flow: $69,878k proceeds from the business combination net of transaction costs, plus $36,835k PIPE proceeds (matches the two PIPE events, $31.8M + $4.99M); 10-K total net $106,713k. Bridge amount changed from $5.0M (10-K narrative, May-Aug) to $5,690k (10-K cash flow; Q3 10-Q says $5,687k over May, June, August and September 2025); closed_on moved to 2025-09-30. The 8-K says 8,524,394 public shares were not redeemed. Bridge loan size conflict: 10-K says gross cash proceeds $5.0M; the Q3 10-Q says aggregate gross proceeds of $5,687 (thousands). Bridge announced_on is month-granular in the source (May to August 2025); 2025-05-01 is a placeholder. The additional PIPE (approx $4.99M) has no stated date beyond 'subsequent to September 23, 2025'; 2025-09-23 is a lower bound. PIPE subscribers are not named in the sources read. Not covered: pre-SPAC private rounds/grants (S-4/424B3 searched for 'raised|capital increase|Series' without result), 2026 post-listing financings (10-Q Aug 2026 not read for offerings/ELOC).
